steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Horror is a genre designed to elicit fear, dread and disgust, confronting audiences with the transgressive, the unknown and the repressed. | Key Fact: Core horror conventions include isolation, the monstrous Other, transgression of boundaries, the return of the repressed and the struggle for survival. | Key Fact: Horror sub-genres include slasher, supernatural, psychological, body horror, found footage, folk horror and gothic horror. | Key Fact: Carol Clover's 'final girl' theory identifies the last surviving female character in slasher films as the figure with whom the audience ultimately identifies.
